answers.note: В лёгочных капиллярах кровь отдаёт углекислый газ и получает кислород.
Клапаны сердца обеспечивают однонаправленное движение крови.
Нефроны фильтруют кровь и помогают поддерживать баланс растворённых веществ.

currentCard.explanation: Сердце перекачивает кровь: его желудочки направляют её к лёгким и в остальные органы. У человека оно состоит из четырёх камер.

source.title: OpenStax Anatomy and Physiology 2e: 19.1 Heart Anatomy

literal.prompt: Какой орган перекачивает кровь по сосудам?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 19.1 L33–34/L60–69/L92 explicitly identifies heart and its ventricular/myocardial pumping of blood through pulmonary/systemic vessels. The other organs genuinely receive/process blood but have different primary roles: lungs exchange gases at pulmonary capillaries(L63/L69), kidneys/nephrons filter/balance blood(25.3 L53–55), liver removes harmful substances(UHB L67). These are plausible blood-associated organ alternatives, not additional pumps in the intended normal circulation. Four comparable short nominative organ names; key1 independently evidenced, not inferred from frozen index.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Сердце перекачивает кровь: его желудочки направляют её к лёгким и в остальные органы. У человека оно состоит из четырёх камер.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 19.1 L60 directly gives four chambers and ventricles as principal pumping chambers. L61–69 explicitly separates right ventricular flow toward lungs and left ventricular flow to systemic tissues. Two Russian sentences name heart, explain ventricular destinations and add chamber count without claiming atria never pump (L60/L136/L148 retain that surrounding context). Under70 words.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: В лёгочных капиллярах кровь отдаёт углекислый газ и получает кислород.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 19.1 L63 explicitly says gas exchange occurs in pulmonary capillaries, carbon dioxide exits blood and oxygen enters;L69 repeats flow and gas directions. This is a precise useful own-lung fact rather than attributing circulation pumping to lungs.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Клапаны сердца обеспечивают однонаправленное движение крови.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 19.1 L109 explicitly identifies valves as specialized structures ensuring one-way blood flow;L140 explains chordae/papillary support preventing regurgitation andL145 pulmonary semilunar backflow prevention. A normal-anatomy statement, not a claim that diseased valves never fail. This adds own-heart structural/function knowledge beyond the question/key heart pumps blood; explanation only adds ventricles/circuits/chamber count.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Нефроны фильтруют кровь и помогают поддерживать баланс растворённых веществ.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: 25.3 L53 states nephrons cleanse blood and balance constituents of circulation;L54 states glomerular capillaries filter blood andL55 recovers solutes/water. The note accurately assigns filtration and dissolved-substance balance to functional units of the own kidney option, not an unsupported blood-pump role.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Печень фильтрует вредные вещества из крови.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: UHB NHS L67 directly states the liver filters harmful substances from blood. The note closely expresses that limited patient-facing organ-function claim, not universal removal of all toxins or an automatic medical treatment recommendation. A useful own-liver fact. No old1/34 liver HOLD or sources are adopted.

fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.note: В лёгочных капиллярах кровь отдаёт углекислый газ и получает кислород.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.grammar: «Лёгкие» is a consistently used standalone nominative organ-name label, natural after «Какой орган ...?»; plural name does not create an inflected-substitution error.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.plausibility: A real blood-associated organ receiving pulmonary circulation, plausible confusion with the organ driving it.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.truthUniqueKey: 19.1 L60/L63 identifies heart ventricles driving flow to lungs; lungs perform gas exchange, not the principal organ pumping blood through vessels. No second key.
fourFullPromptAnswerNoteVariants.noteTruthUsefulness: L63/L69 explicitly supports blood releasing CO2 and gainingO2 in pulmonary capillaries, useful own-option teaching rather than a wrong-pump claim.

absoluteLevel.assessment: Heart as the organ pumping blood is broad adult school/general knowledge. No chamber-specific anatomy, nephron mechanics or valve names needed to solve. Alternatives are real blood-associated organs, with plausible processing/gas-exchange confusion for a player lacking exact basic physiology. Key not chosen by an absurd distractor, format, authorPASS or frozen index.

correctNoteExtraFact.fact: Heart valves ensure one-way blood flow.
correctNoteExtraFact.ground: Prompt/key name blood-pumping organ, not its directional valve mechanism.19.1 L109 directly supplies this own-heart structure/function fact, with specific no-backflow contextL140/L145. Explanation has chambers/circuits rather than simply restating this note.
